title: Joplin State of the Community 2027
seo_title: Joplin State of the Community 2027 in Joplin, MO
description: Joplin State of the Community is the city's 2nd annual event, where attendees have breakfast, connect with others, and learn what their local government is working to achieve. It is a business networking event. It takes place on January 27, 2027 (Time TBD) at the Harry M. Cornell Arts & Entertainment Complex, 212 West 7th Street, Joplin, MO.
venue: Harry M. Cornell Arts & Entertainment Complex
